Module 1: Crafting Effective AI Prompts
narration: Namaste and welcome to The Art of the Prompt - A Guide for Everyone.
This tutorial is Module 1, Episode 1.
It focuses on crafting effective AI prompts.
Good prompts help AI tools give you useful results.
Here, you will learn to write clear instructions for AI.
This will help you get better and more relevant outputs for your tasks.

slides.title: What is a Prompt?
content: A prompt is your instruction to the AI.
Weak: 'Write something.'
Good: 'Write a short story.'
Better: 'Write a short story about a brave mouse.'
Excellent: 'Write a short story, exactly 200 words, about a brave mouse who saves a lost bird. The story should have a happy ending.'
narration: What exactly is a prompt?
It is simply your instruction to the AI.
It tells the AI what you want to achieve.
Let's look at an example.
A weak prompt is 'Write something'.
This gives a generic, unhelpful output.
A good prompt is 'Write a short story'.
This is better, but still broad.
A better prompt is 'Write a short story about a brave mouse'.
This prompt is now focused on a specific subject.
An excellent prompt adds all necessary details.
For example, consider this prompt.
'Write a short story, exactly 200 words.
It's about a brave mouse who saves a lost bird.
The story should have a happy ending.'
This leads to a focused story that meets all criteria.
Clear prompts lead to specific results.
slides.image_prompt: A visual progression from a very vague, cloudy thought bubble representing 'Write something' to a highly detailed, structured thought bubble with text and icons representing 'short story', '200 words', 'brave mouse', 'lost bird', 'happy ending'. slides.title: Be Specific: Guiding AI's Focus
content: Vague prompts give vague answers.
Add details: topic, audience, purpose.
Basic: 'Explain Quantum Physics.'
Advanced: 'Explain Quantum Physics to a high school student in 3 short paragraphs. Focus on superposition and entanglement, using simple analogies.'
narration: Vague prompts always lead to vague answers.
You must guide the AI's focus effectively.
Tell the AI exactly what information you need.
Include details about your topic, audience, and purpose.
Consider this basic prompt: 'Explain Quantum Physics'.
The AI will likely give a very complex, long explanation.
Now, look at this advanced prompt.
It asks to 'Explain Quantum Physics to a high school student in 3 short paragraphs'.
It specifies to 'Focus on superposition and entanglement, using simple analogies'.
This prompt is concise and targeted.
It uses accessible language.
It clearly defines the audience and specific concepts.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing sharply on a specific, complex diagram of quantum physics. On one side, a blurred, general image of physics, and on the other, a simplified diagram with analogies like 'wave' and 'particle' represented by relatable icons. A high school student figure is observing.

slides.title: Define Role & Set Constraints
content: Define Role: AI acts as a persona.
Basic: 'Explain how to fix a leaky faucet.'
Advanced: 'Act as a witty DIY blogger. Explain how to fix a leaky faucet, including mistakes and tool recommendations, with humor.'
Set Constraints: Control output length and format.
Basic: 'List benefits of exercise.'
Advanced: 'List 5 benefits of exercise. For each, provide a 1-sentence explanation and example. Format as an HTML unordered list.'
narration: You can tell the AI to act as a specific persona.
This is called 'Defining the Role'.
It changes the AI's tone and overall style.
For example, 'Explain how to fix a leaky faucet' gives standard instructions.
However, a role-defined prompt gives more engaging advice.
It asks for fixing a leaky faucet, including mistakes, tools, and humor.
This results in engaging, practical advice.
Next, 'Set Constraints' to control the output.
Specify length, format, and what to include or exclude.
A basic request like 'List benefits of exercise' gives a simple list.
However, a constrained prompt provides structured output.
It asks for '5 benefits of exercise', each with a 1-sentence explanation and example.
It also specifies to 'Format as an HTML unordered list'.
This ensures precise content and structure.
Applying these techniques enhances AI's utility.
slides.image_prompt: A split image. On one side, a theatrical mask and various tools (wrench, hammer) representing 'Define Role'. On the other, a ruler and a checklist representing 'Set Constraints'. Both sides are connected to a visual of an AI generating tailored content.

slides.title: Iterate and Refine
content: Your first prompt might not be perfect.
Refine based on AI's initial response.
Prompt 1: 'Write about dogs.' (Too general)
Refinement 1: 'That was too general. Write about Golden Retrievers, focusing on their friendly nature.' (Better focus)

Refinement 2: 'Good. Now, write a short paragraph about Golden Retrievers' friendly nature, specifically mentioning suitability as family pets and patience with children. Use an encouraging tone.' (Focused and detailed)
narration: Remember, your first prompt might not be perfect.
It is perfectly okay to refine your prompts.
Think of it as an ongoing conversation with the AI.
Let's trace an example.
Prompt 1: 'Write about dogs'.
This gives very general text.
We refine it: 'Too general. Write about Golden Retrievers' friendly nature'.
Now the AI provides text specifically about their temperament.
We refine it again for more detail.
The prompt now asks for 'a short paragraph about Golden Retrievers' friendly nature'.
It specifically mentions 'suitability as family pets and patience with children'.
It also specifies to 'Use an encouraging tone'.
This iterative process leads to a focused paragraph.
It includes all desired details and tone.
Iteration is crucial for optimal AI results.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation of an iterative process: a user typing a prompt, an AI generating a response, the user then typing a 'refinement' prompt, and the AI generating an improved response. Use circular arrows to show the feedback loop of improvement. An eraser icon symbolizes 'refinement'.

slides.title: Summary
content: Clear and specific instructions are key.
Define AI's role and set output constraints.
Iterate and refine prompts based on results.
Good prompting is an ongoing conversation.
narration: Let us summarize what we have learned.
First, clear and specific instructions are key for effective prompts.
Avoid any vagueness in your requests.
Second, define the AI's role clearly.
Set specific constraints on the output format and length.
Third, always iterate and refine your prompts.
Do this based on the AI's initial responses.
Remember, good prompting is an ongoing conversation with the AI.
This approach consistently leads to better results.

slides.title: Assignment: Recipe Creation
content: Goal: Get a healthy, budget-friendly dinner recipe, <20 min prep, using pantry ingredients (rice, beans, frozen veggies).
Step 1: Basic prompt: 'Give me a dinner recipe.'
Step 2: Refine: 'Make it healthy and budget-friendly.'
Step 3: Add detail: 'Needs <20 min, use rice, canned beans, frozen vegetables.'
Step 4: Add persona & format: 'Act as a busy home cook. List ingredients as bullet points, steps as numbered instructions.'
narration: Now it is your turn!
Use an AI language model for this assignment: Recipe Creation.
Your goal is to get a healthy, budget-friendly dinner recipe.
It should take less than 20 minutes to prepare.
It must use common pantry ingredients.
First, start with a basic prompt like 'Give me a dinner recipe'.
Then, refine it: 'Make it healthy and budget-friendly'.
Next, add more specific details.
The prompt states: '<20 minutes prep, use rice, canned beans, and frozen vegetables'.
Finally, add a persona and format.
Ask the AI to 'Act as a busy home cook'.
Instruct it to 'List ingredients as bullet points, steps as numbered instructions'.
Compare your initial and final AI outputs to see the difference.
slides.image_prompt: A split screen showing a simple, generic recipe output on one side and a detailed, well-formatted recipe with bulleted ingredients and numbered steps on the other. A busy person in a kitchen is happy with the improved recipe. Icons for rice, beans, frozen vegetables are present.
